{{Top|sprot}}
[[File:Nexu-BtR.png|right|thumb|200p|[[Nexu/Legends|Nexu]] were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], [[Feline/Legends|feline]] mammal]]
A '''Mammal''' was any of a class of [[Endothermy|warm-blooded]] [[vertebrate]]s that had the skin more or less covered with [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and usually [[Reproduction/Legends|bore]] their [[Youngling/Legends|young]] live from the [[Womb/Legends|womb]] and fully developed, resembling miniature versions of their [[Parent/Legends|parents]]. Some, however, have been known to lay [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] e.g. [[monotreme]]s. Regardless of the birth process, all mammals [[Foodstuff/Legends|nourished]] their young with [[Milk/Legends|milk]] secreted by the [[Breast/Legends|mammary glands]] of [[Gender/Legends|females]]. [[Human/Legends|Humans]] were mammals, and so were [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]. Subgroups of mammals included the [[Cetacean/Legends|cetacean]], [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]], [[marsupial]]s, [[Primate/Legends|primates]],<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> and [[pachydermoid]]s.<ref name="GG12">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>

[[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] felt that the way some individuals allowed their temper to rule them, particularly [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]], was a legacy of their mammalian heritage.<ref name="Shadows of the Empire">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>
